values.title: Notice on Preserving Evidence in Online Food Cases
values.body: The Court reminds you to properly preserve the physical food, order and payment records, product page, customer service communications, unboxing materials, and medical receipts.

values.title: Notice on Preserving Evidence and Physical Items in Online Food Cases
values.summary: The parties should retain the order, payment records, product page, customer-service communications, unboxing materials, and the food involved in the case. For specialized food-safety issues, they may lawfully apply to a qualified institution for testing.
